## Overview

- Expand editable Mermaid PowerPoint export across systems, requirement diagrams, kanban, block, quadrant, XY, Gantt, treemap, Ishikawa, mindmap, timeline, and journey diagrams.
- Improve Mermaid theme contrast across diagram formats and add documented image fallbacks for unsupported representations.
- Add Mermaid image export options, tightly cropped PowerPoint artwork, per-slide background images, and Azure hub-spoke architecture examples.
- Keep the Canvas Extension, Agent Skills, CLI, and Desktop on the unified 3.5.0 release.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible for existing Markdown decks. No migration is required.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v3.5.0`. |
| Mermaid PowerPoint export | Review exported diagrams when using newly supported Mermaid formats; unsupported representations continue to use image fallbacks. |
